title: Integrated RRT completes none of its four original cases.
summary: The qualified local controller now supplies checked control sequences to RRT. Under unchanged budgets, 84 requests produce 24 admissible partial connections, but none reaches the first timed checkpoint. Independent admission retains all four misses.
boundary: One frozen seed per exposed case; 71,986 transitions charged. Full masks cover 38 selected states. Local control qualification does not establish planner qualification, source recovery, transfer or superiority.
next: Compare useful expansion per unit of work under matched constraints. All four original cases must qualify before source comparison; no retry or retuning changes this closed result.
